WITH country_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_avgs
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.country,
    ca.avg_wins,
    om.overall_avg,
    ca.avg_wins - om.overall_avg as excess_overall
  FROM country_avgs ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > om.overall_avg
),
above_group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as group_avg FROM above_overall
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    aa.country,
    aa.avg_wins,
    aa.overall_avg,
    aa.excess_overall,
    ag.group_avg,
    aa.avg_wins - ag.group_avg as excess_group
  FROM above_overall aa
  CROSS JOIN above_group_mean ag
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > ag.group_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_wins) as mean_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(excess_overall) as mean_excess_overall,
  AVG(excess_group) as mean_excess_group
FROM final_countries

assumptions.assumption: The condition 'above the mean' uses strictly greater-than (>) not greater-than-or-equal, following standard usage
All constructorStandings rows for each circuit country are included in the average, with no year or season filtering
